 1 | Flowstop I | 1 target | - | touch | U

 4 | Flowstop V | 1 target | - | touch | U
 5 | Limb Preservation | 1 limb | 1 day/lvl | touch | U
 6 | Cut Repair I | 1 target | P | touch | U

 8 | Minor Vessel Repair | 1 target | P | touch | U
 9 | Cut Repair III | target | P | touch | U
10 | Major Vessel Repair | 1 target | P | touch | U
12 | Joining | 1 target | P | touch | U
13 | Flowstop True | 1 target | - | touch | U
14 | Clotting True | 1 target | - | touch | U
16 | Unclotting | 1 target | P | touch | U
18 | Cut Repair True | 1 target | - | touch | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round;
target may not be moved, or bleeding will resume at prior rate.
@@ 2
As Flowstop I, except that caster can stop up to 3 hits per round (total)
bleeding on a wound.
@@ 3
Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round;
for 1 hour, target can move at no more than a walking pace, or bleeding will
resume at prior rate.
@@ 4
As Flowstop I, except that caster can stop up to 5 hits per round (total)
bleeding on a wound.
@@ 5
Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed).
Also requires use of same spells from Muscle Law, Bone Law, and Nerve Law.
@@ 6
Allows caster to stop bleeding from 1 wound that is bleeding 1 hit per round.
@@ 7
As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is
bleeding up to 3 hits per round (total).
@@ 8
Allows caster to completely mend a damaged minor blood vessel (a vessel that
bleeds at up to 4 hits per round, not major arteries or veins).
@@ 9
As Cut Repair I, except that caster can repair wound(s) that bleed(s) up to 3
hits per round (total); three 1 hit per round wounds or one 3 hit per round
wound or one 2 hit per round and one 1 hit per round wound can be healed.
@@ 10
Allows caster to repair 1 damaged blood vessel of any size, including severed
veins and arteries; recovery time: 1d10 days, depending on size of vessel and
severity of damage. A major vessel is one that bleeds at 5 hit per round or
more when severed.
@@ 12
Allows caster to reattach severed limb; also requires use of Bone Law, Muscle
Law, and Nerve Law Joining spells in order to restore functional status; limb
is fully functional in 10-100 days.
@@ 13
As Flow Stoppage I, except that all blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one
wound is stopped.
@@ 14
As Clotting I, except that blood loss (i.e., hits per round) from one wound is
stopped.
@@ 16
Allows caster to remove any one blood clot; will counter Clotting Curse (on
the Curses list, p. 62). This spell has no affect on bleeding wounds that have
clotted (i.e., “clots” in this sense apply only to internal blood clotting).
@@ 18
As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.
@@ 20
As Flow Stoppage True, except that caster may stop bleeding from a number of
wounds equal to his level (e.g., a 20th level caster can stop bleeding from 20
wounds).
@@ 25
As Joining, except that limb is fully functional in 10 minutes (provided
caster also uses the other three Joining True spells).
@@ 30
As Mass Flow Stoppage, except that bleeding is stopped as in Clotting True.
@@ 50
Allows caster to stop bleeding in, and fully repair, 1 wound per level (e.g.,
a 50th level caster can fully repair a total of 50 wounds/spell cast).
